name: tiberiansun
title: Tiberian Sun (OpenTS P4 Port)
description: Staged ESP32-P4 port of OpenTS Tiberian Sun. It decrypts original MIX indexes, mounts the SD-card data layer, parses campaign and mission metadata, validates IsoMapPack5 terrain framing in PSRAM, and keeps a visible runtime shell alive on the device.
author: Westwood / Electronic Arts; OpenTS contributors; PAX port
about: This development package follows OpenTS archive precedence, reads encrypted MIX directories directly from the SD card, resolves MAPSEL01 campaign stages, parses mission metadata and object counts, validates IsoMapPack5 Base64/LZO framing in PSRAM, and presents the live port status until the loader close control is used.
changelog: 0.0.5-dev: run MIX probing and runtime shell on a tracked 64 KiB PSRAM stack; 0.0.4-dev: campaign stage and IsoMapPack5 terrain framing validation; 0.0.3-dev: persistent P4 runtime shell with framebuffer status and orderly close; 0.0.2-dev: encrypted MIX decryption, OpenTS-style archive mounting, and PSRAM INI loading

FILES / FOLDERS

/sd/roms/tiberiansun/tibsun.mix — Base Tiberian Sun data

/sd/roms/tiberiansun/maps01.mix — Base map data

/sd/roms/tiberiansun/multi.mix — Multiplayer map data
